Guidance & outlook: So our revenue from operations stood at INR29.14 crores in Q1 FY27 as against INR20.48 crores in Q1 FY26.
Total income increased to INR31.19 crores in Q1 FY27 compared with INR20.58 crores in Q1 FY26, reflecting a healthy 51.55% Y-o-Y growth.
Z-Tech (India) Limited August 14, 2026 EBITDA margin was 22.82% in Q1 FY27 compared with 24.51% in Q1 FY26.
Growth & demand: The FY26-'27, the Q1, the Creative Park division gave a result of almost INR22-odd crores compared to around INR15 crores in the previous quarter of '25-'26, representing a growth of over 40%.
The Terra vertical, which is the geosynthetic vertical, the revenue increased from almost INR5 crores to INR7.5 crores in this quarter of this year, a growth of approximately almost 48%.
It grew strongly by 42.29 percentage year-on-year growth.
Margins & costs: EBITDA, excluding other income, stood at INR6.65 crores, up from INR5.02 crores in the corresponding quarter last year, representing 32.47% Y-o-Y growth.
